Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: If you somehow find a Tim Kweertons around here -- I do not believe you can, because there is a lack of Kweemerican chains too -- I would prefer it if you leave me out of it.

Line.Text: I have bad associations with it. And the food is no better than what Kweemericans produce.

Choices.Text: Do you have 'bad associations' because *that* was your seedhood?
